stories.headline: My Dream Game is Finally Ready to Play After 25 Days With AI
stories.body: A 25-day development log of a feature-complete RTS game built solo using an AI-agent-centric pipeline. It demonstrates the use of video-based motion references to drive 3D creature animation for non-humanoids like scorpions and dryads.
stories.why: This workflow focuses on rapid asset iteration where AI agents handle the 'heavy lifting' of rigging and retopology. In a USD pipeline, this would be highly effective for generating background assets, crowd agents, or high-fidelity proxies. The 'Context Wiki' approach is a transferable strategy for keeping multi-modal AI tools (textures, sound, model) aligned with a single creative vision.

whats_transferable: Using a centralized project Wiki (Markdown/HTML) to provide context to LLM agents for consistent character attributes and skill matrices.
Applying Tripo AI's 'Smart UV' and 'Smart Mesh' for automated retopology and UV unwrapping of generated 3D meshes.
Chaining video AI (as motion reference) with 3D agents to automate complex creature rigging and animation cycles in Blender.
Using LLM-generated HTML illustrations to define timing and choreography for VFX before implementation in the game engine.
